instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Energy services company providing energy efficiency audits, HVAC optimization, and building management system integration for commercial and industrial clients. Completed 200+ projects across hospitals, hotels, and manufacturing plants. Developing an IoT-based real-time energy monitoring platform. Operate from 2-3 locations or departments. We have some budget headroom for experimentation but look for quick wins that can demonstrate value within 6 months before committing to longer-term programs. The leadership team is aligned on the need to modernize but debates where to start.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 8 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Developing a De-risked Diversification Strategy
opportunities.rationale: The high concentration risk (55% revenue from top 3 clients) is the most critical threat to long-term stability. This requires shifting focus from incremental process improvements to defining entirely new, non-correlated revenue streams or business models.

first_actions: Conduct a comprehensive portfolio analysis of current and adjacent energy service markets (e.g., focusing on residential/commercial segments outside the top 3 client vertical).
Develop two distinct, high-potential pilot business models that leverage existing core competencies (HVAC optimization, audits) but target new customer profiles.
Establish a cross-functional 'Future Ventures' task force involving sales, finance, and technical leads to model potential profitability.
resources_needed: External market consultant (specializing in energy service models)
Dedicated time allocation from senior leadership/Strategy lead
Access to historical non-top-3 client data
execution_plan.success_metric: Identification and successful scoping of at least one viable, revenue-generating pilot business model outside the top 3 client base.
milestones: Approved selection of two target diversification models (Month 4)
Initiation of the first pilot program MVP build (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Optimizing Supply Chain Resilience via Digital Inventory Management
opportunities.rationale: Supply chain disruptions hit multiple product lines, increasing risk and compressing margins. Completing the inventory digitalization project is crucial for stabilizing operations and allowing better resource allocation.

first_actions: Finalize integration of IoT data feeds into the core ERP/inventory system to provide real-time stock visibility across all 2-3 locations.
Implement automated reorder points based on actual usage rates and supplier lead time variance, minimizing buffer stock while ensuring service continuity.
Develop standardized process documentation for handling critical component shortages due to disruptions.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of reported inventory stock-outs on critical components by 25% within the next quarter.
milestones: Successful real-time data flow pilot completion (Month 1.5)
Training and adoption across all regional departments (Month 3)
Demonstrated reduction in expedited shipping costs (Quarterly)

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal client segmentation and risk modeling exercise to map revenue dependency and identify non-core, low-risk clients suitable for cross-selling/pilot programs.
Define the full scope and data requirements (data governance, APIs) for integrating IoT platform data with existing CRM/ERP systems to enable service productization.

Develop a financial model and target list for potential new revenue streams, focusing on adjacent service offerings (e.g., predictive maintenance contracts) rather than completely unrelated industries.

key_weaknesses: High revenue concentration risk, creating single points of failure in the client base.
Lack of a formalized, proactive strategic planning mechanism that moves beyond reactive problem-solving (tactical execution).
Process gaps in converting collected data (IoT, CRM) into standardized, profitable service blueprints.

improvements: Successful launch/progress on Inventory Digitalization project.
Leadership team alignment on the necessity of modernization and strategic change (diversification).
Exploring advanced digital capabilities (Marketing Automation, AI lead scoring) building on CRM success.
persistent_gaps: The primary barrier remains defining *where* to diversify strategically, requiring executive consensus and time.
Process mapping around new integrated data workflows is incomplete.
Full execution of the secondary digital steps (Marketing Automation, AI scoring) has not yet started.
achieved_milestones: CRM system successfully implemented 18 months ago, providing a stable foundation for further automation.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Increased operational focus (inventory digitalization launched) and a clear recognition of critical strategic risk (client concentration). Progress is moving from assessment/planning into concrete execution on digital tools, though the ultimate strategy remains undefined.
